### Version 0.1.225
- Security: manager signs in with each staff member's WordPress account only; no WooCommerce keys in the browser
- Security: remove hardcoded third-party keys (Biteship, Telegram, Acumbamail, Shopee, TikTok, revalidation) from the plugin
- Security: order cancel needs the order key, AWB and tracking sync need staff sign-in, unverified Shopee/TikTok pushes only trigger a fresh API read
